ops.label: wayfinder:grilling
ops.title: Which five Zones does the Timezone Board show?
ops.body:
Part of #8

## Question

Which five fixed Zones appear on the Timezone Board, and what city label and IANA timezone id does each use?

Recommendation to accept unless overridden: London (`Europe/London`), New York (`America/New_York`), Los Angeles (`America/Los_Angeles`), Tokyo (`Asia/Tokyo`), Sydney (`Australia/Sydney`).

ops.label: wayfinder:grilling
ops.title: What does the Glance view show and how does it update?
ops.body:
Part of #8

## Question

For each Zone on the Glance view, what information is shown, and how does the display stay current?

Recommendation to accept unless overridden: city label, large local time (hours:minutes:seconds), weekday and date, and UTC offset; the clocks tick every second; no secondary panels, stats, or conversion tools on the Glance view.

ops.label: wayfinder:grilling
ops.title: What stack and deploy target for the Timezone Board demo?
ops.body:
Part of #8

## Question

What implementation stack and deploy target should the eventual spec assume for this demo?

Recommendation to accept unless overridden: Vite + vanilla TypeScript static site in the workshop repo (dedicated project folder), deployable as a static site (for example Render static or GitHub Pages). No backend, no package-manager sprawl beyond Vite.

ops.label: wayfinder:grilling
ops.title: What visual direction for the Glance view?
ops.body:
Part of #8

## Question

What visual direction should the Glance view follow so a prototype can be judged against something concrete?

Recommendation to accept unless overridden: one full-bleed composition; brand/title "Timezone Board" as a hero-level signal; light cool slate palette with strong expressive typography; atmospheric background (gradient or subtle pattern, not flat fill); five Zones as the primary content after the title, not cards-in-a-dashboard. Avoid purple-on-white, cream-and-terracotta, broadsheet density, and default dark mode.

ops.body:

## Question

Does a cheap, concrete Glance view prototype (layout, typography, five Zones live or mocked) feel right for the demo, and what must change before the product understanding is ready for `/to-spec`?

Raise fidelity with `/prototype`. Link the prototype artifact from this issue. Keep the learning; disposable code may be deleted after the reaction is recorded.

ops.label: wayfinder:grilling
ops.title: Is the prototype ready for the product spec?
ops.body:
Part of #8

## Question

After reacting to the Rough Timezone Board UI prototype, is the product understanding clear enough to leave this map and run `/to-spec` (then `/to-tickets`), or must another prototype/grilling pass happen first?

Recommendation to accept unless overridden: if the prototype matches the closed decisions on Zones, Glance view behavior, and visual direction with only minor polish notes, declare the map complete and proceed to `/to-spec`.
